blurb: Our great location, beach and, pool make a great place to dock your boat for the night, weekend or season.

quotes.text: We enjoyed our one night stay at the marina! Very helpful staff and beautiful floating docks. The tiki bar was awesome with great food and great staff. It’s perfectly located if you want easy access to and from the Chesapeake Bay. The marina is undergoing renovations, which is great to see. The fueling dock served its purpose but needs some work. And the channel depth was a little skinny for us (4 ft draft), especially at low tide. But this marina has every makings of a five star place once the renovations are completed. We’re looking forward to our next stay!

Great marina. One of the most picturesque in the Bay. Docking help as soon as I arrived (late mind you- they were there for me!). Perfectly protected, excellent facilities. Wish I was there in season (eg, Tiki bar was not yet open). Is just a stones throw from open Bay, making it a great lay up if going north or south past the mouth of the Rappahannock. Would definitely stay again

Marina is pretty rough. After touching bottom on the way in, we needed a pump out and it cost $20! The place looks like it’s frozen in time - well past its heyday. The pool looked inviting, but the amenities appeared in disrepair. No tiki bar, no restaurant- lots of open slips and the property looks unfinished. Sorry.

This was our first visit ever to windmill point marina and we loved it. Absolutely stunning views and such friendly service. The pool is large right on the Chesapeake Bay and the tiki bar had great bar food. This really exceeded our expectations and we will definitely return!

Both ladies and men's shower areas had leftover towels rags soap even clothes laying around even on the hooks so we couldn't use the hooks. The bath houses need to be more closely attended for sure. The ladies restroom had no toilet paper in three out of the four stalls.

Windmill point was a easy in and out for us headed south. The marina manager Tony was extremely helpful and let us use a loaner car to pick up supplies for the boat. We will be back on our way north and can't to see the new beach and all the upgrades in the works!
